candidate_workaround: Rename the ordinary accessibility field to a semantically equivalent user-agent-diversity label and rerun the unchanged five-class scanner.
failure_signature: The first current validator reported one confirmed private-callable candidate in a structural accessibility artifact even though the matched field contained no callable identifier.
recurrence_guard: Avoid ordinary public schema labels that begin with reserved private-callable prefixes; never suppress or weaken the scanner to make a collision disappear.
rollback: Preserve the failed validator receipt, change only the colliding public field label, regenerate the bounded artifact, and rerun the unchanged scanner.
scope_boundary: Lexical scanner collision only; not complete privacy assurance, accessibility conformance, or exhaustive security.
title: Resolve public schema collisions without weakening privacy scans
